scripts.build: npm run build -w @nutwala/shared && npm run build -w @nutwala/api && npm run build -w @nutwala/web && npm run build -w @nutwala/admin
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nutwala/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web,admin -c gray,blue,green,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @nutwala/shared" "npm run dev -w @nutwala/api" "npm run dev -w @nutwala/web" "npm run dev -w @nutwala/admin"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nutwala/shared && npm run test -w @nutwala/api && npm run test -w @nutwala/web && npm run test -w @nutwala/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @nutwala/api && npm run lint -w @nutwala/web && npm run lint -w @nutwala/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nutwala/api && npm run typecheck -w @nutwala/web && npm run typecheck -w @nutwala/admin
